notes.title: Origami Lovers Release!
notes.notes:
[b]Origami Lovers[/b] is now officially available on Steam!! Thank you for joining us on this journey and we are extremely excited to finally share the game with all of you. We hope you enjoy your time in our little cardboard world🌸

[b]Origami Lovers[/b] is about finding your origami friend after stranding on an island. On the way there, you will need to explore and traverse the island that is ahead of you. You will have to find new origami figurines, that you can shapeshift into and use their abilities in the level. While linear gameplay lasts about 30 minutes, embark on a sweet and short journey to rescue your lost friend. Different playstyles like speedrunning or collecting crowns provide more playtime.


[h2]Watch the new Origami Lovers Trailer now:[/h2]
[previewyoutube=JQGrSuj4pz8;full][/previewyoutube]



[h3]Key Features of Origami Lovers: [/h3]
[list]
[*][b]Bite-Sized Brilliance: [/b] Dive into a 20-30 minute origami adventure, perfect for quick escapes or repeated plays. 
[*][b]Origami Odyssey:[/b] Transform into unique paper shapes to unlock special abilities, unveil secret paths and find hidden crowns.
[*][b]Crafted World:[/b] Immerse in a stunning 3D platformer landscape inspired by paper, origami, and cardboard artistry.
[*][b]Speedrunner's Delight:[/b] Challenge yourself in "Hardcore"-mode, race against time, and climb the leaderboards.
[/list]

notes.title: Origami Lovers Release Stream
notes.notes: After more than 1.5 years, Origami Lovers is now available for purchase on Steam! We are incredibly excited and want to share that feeling with you. Join us and celebrate the game release with us.
